description: A refresh token with its login family (tables REFRESH_TOKEN + TOKEN_FAMILY).

family_id.description: Login (session) family, a UUID shared by all tokens of one login.

family_created_at.description: Moment the family was created (UTC), copied from its first token.

user_id.description: Owner of the family, the _id of a document in users.

token_hash.description: SHA-256 of the token, 64 lower-case hex digits.

expires_at.description: Moment the token stops working (UTC), issue time plus 30 days; a TTL index removes the document later.

revoked.description: true once the token was rotated or its family revoked.
